AltoPay onboarding nearly complete, low latency. ArcLabs tokens -6% WoW, errors up (toolcall 500s), renewal at-risk; scheduling EBR.

routes | WoW | QoQ

Leo: Saw the Solstice spike. Root cause = KV-cache misses on instances with mixed model variants. Increasing sticky routing and applying cache tweak now. Deployed to staging, will roll to prod in 30m if green.

Anika: I'll book a 30m enablement session with AltoPay next Wed 10:00am PT and follow-up docs. Also will prep a renewal health slide for ArcLabs — can we get error samples?

Maya: @Anika added error snippets below and correlation to payload size. Example 500: "tool invocation failed: timeout to toolrunner" with payload ~1.8MB. Also note ArcLabs has long avg seq len so per-token cost high.

ops-bot: Reminder: EBR candidate list updated — ArcLabs flagged (low usage + elevated errors). Owner: Anika.
